bio.en: Zhe-Yi Li is an architecture student currently pursuing a Master's degree at National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST).
bio.zh: 李哲逸（Zhe-YI Li）是一位建築學生，目前正在台灣科技大學攻讀碩士學位。

bioSub.en: Having recently earned his Bachelor's degree in Architecture, he is actively exploring each stage of life—believing that the journey itself is the scenery, while the outcome is a postcard.
bioSub.zh: 剛從建築系取得學士學位，目前正積極的開拓人生的每一站，並認為這些過程都是風景，而結果是明信片。

institution.en: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST)

title.en: National Tainan First Senior High School

institution.zh: 楊士正建築師事務所，台南

title.zh: 畢業設計作品，入選大評圖
